crossRefs.note: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.
but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.
The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.
I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”
Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.
My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,
For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,
“Listen to me, you who know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law. Don’t fear the reproach of men, and…
Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words were to me a joy and the rejoicing of my heart, for I am called by…
But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.
And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth. He was subject to them, and his mother kept all these sayings in her…
Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and…
Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will…

translations.web: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
translations.bsb: I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.
translations.kjv: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin
translations.asv: Thy word have I laid up in my heart, That I might not sin against thee.
